verdict.rationale: Ollama documents headless operation: a one-line shell install script, a local REST API server at localhost:11434 with an OpenAPI spec, curl examples, Python/JS libraries, and cloud calls by API key with no installation required. Community reports confirm it running unattended behind a bot and in ROCm containers. However, the pack has no first-party guidance on CI pipelines, containers or non-interactive automation. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD usage (e.g. GitHub Actions recipes), official headless/daemon or container deployment docs, non-interactive CLI flags for scripted runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
Learn the local and cloud base URLs, then send a request with curl.
Call cloud models with an API key. No Ollama installation required.
They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
